UX surfaceShared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

(module scope)

Per-surface parameters for mountCornerBrackets — the pieces the button styles differ in.

canvasClass

Overlay canvas class (the :has() gate keys on it).

insetVar

CSS var the hover inset resolves from — calc(100% − var).

ease

Cubic-bezier control points of the surface's CSS transition.

ms

Expansion ramp duration (ms) — ANIMATION_DURATIONS.BRACKET* tokens.

(module scope)

Element whose hover/focus drives the ramp — defaults to button. .expand-modal-open-1 animates on .internal-expand:hover & (the parent), so callers pass that ancestor here.

(module scope)

Ancestor selector alternative to hoverOn — resolved per button (button.closest(...)) so batch mounts each watch their own parent.

(module scope)

Kind-specific wasm surface for the corner-brackets crate — typed on top of the generic WasmWidget so calls stay checked.

set_hover

Eased hover progress 0..1 — arm length + tint lerp.

set_arms

Stub/full arm lengths + hairline half-width (device px).

set_colors

Resting + hover bracket colors (rgba 0-1).

bezierEase

bezierEase — evaluate cubic-bezier(x1,y1,x2,y2) at progress p. CSS resolves y at the parameter t where x(t)=p — Newton's method on the x polynomial, four iterations like the WGSL bez (the two must agree pixel-for-pixel or the GPU arm grows on a different clock than the CSS one it replaces).

  • @param p Linear progress 0..1.
  • @param x1 @param y1 @param x2 @param y2 Control-point coordinates.
  • @returns Eased progress 0..1.

cssLength

cssLength — resolve a CSS length (e.g. var(--space-xs)) to px in the element's style scope: a probe span inherits the same custom properties, so shadow-DOM-scoped values resolve correctly. Returns 0 when probing is impossible.

  • @param el Element whose scope the length resolves in.
  • @param value Any CSS width value.

mountCornerBrackets

Mounts the corner-brackets widget inside button. The canvas is a position:absolute; inset:0 child — it follows the button's box for free, so only the backing size + arm lengths need mirroring.

  • @param button The bracketed button/link element.
  • @param spec Per-surface parameters (canvas class, hover inset, ease).
  • @returns Teardown function; safe to call more than once.

layout

Pushes the box-dependent parameters: stub arm = the pseudo-box's resting size (read off ::before's computed style), full arm = the button's own span minus the surface's inset, hairline = the pseudo-border's width — all converted to the canvas's device px.

colors

Pushes the resting + hover bracket colors — re-run on every ramp retarget so currentColor borders (which resolve against the button's transitioning text color) paint the correct hover tint while :hover applies.

tick

One ramp tick — ease the hover scalar toward its target and paint.

watched

Element whose hover/focus state the CSS brackets key on.

retarget

Retargets the ramp — hover/focus state changed on the watched element.

mountCornerBracketsAll

Batch mount — one mountCornerBrackets per matching element under root (a component shadow root or any parent). Returns a single teardown that destroys them all; surfaces that re-render call it then re-query (the helper tolerates re-mounting on new nodes).

  • @param root The subtree to query.
  • @param selector Class selector for the bracketed elements.
  • @param spec Shared surface parameters.
  • @returns Teardown for every mounted bracket.
